missions.title: The Resurrection Ward
missions.brief: Six of you wake in sleeves you never chose, in a year you never lived. Someone broke the law to get you out.
missions.gm: Establish the sleeves, 2384 and the 110-year gap; Serin, H01 and the first pulse. Exit: the recovery team arrives.

objectives.text: Each PC establishes their current sleeve, the year 2384 and the 110-year gap.
objectives.player: Learn what body you are wearing and what year it is.

objectives.text: Give H01, the Continuity Withdrawal Receipt.
objectives.player: Find the paperwork that explains why you were held.

objectives.text: Serin names the two protected reserves.
objectives.player: Find out who else was stored with you.

objectives.text: Run the first announced continuity pulse (Ward).
objectives.player: Face the first dislocation.

cast.note: Dr Serin Kael. Offers water to organic sleeves, a diagnostic lead to synthetics. Examines no one without permission.
cast.label: Dr Serin Kael

missions.title: Breach of Cold Storage
missions.brief: A recovery team has come for your stacks — intact, and quietly.
missions.gm: A custody dispute, not a mandatory fight. Jalen leads; Asha only on a secure call. End on terms, escape or a defensible transfer dispute.

objectives.text: Obtain the intact-stack retrieval order H02.
objectives.player: See the order that came for you.

objectives.text: Resolve the custody dispute: negotiate, comply under witnessed custody, deceive or evade.
objectives.player: Decide how you leave the ward — and in whose custody.

objectives.text: Leave by a traceable exit toward the Rainline (or knowingly surrender to the Spire).
objectives.player: Get out into the city.

cast.note: Jalen Cross leads the team with the Retrieval Hitman profile (G27). Opens with an offer to discuss custody.
cast.name: Jalen Cross
cast.label: Palimpsest Retrieval Hitman

cast.note: Recovery personnel: they do not all attack before the party can act.
cast.name: Recovery Personnel
cast.label: Compromised Protectorate Officer

cast.note: On a secure call only — no token in this scene.

missions.title: The Rainline
missions.brief: Three doors into the century you lost: paper, cargo or relays. Somebody on each side of them needs something from you.
missions.gm: Choose one to three leads by schedule. Skipped packets arrive at Anansi House. One leading contact and one relationship contact per visited location.

objectives.text: Choose and visit at least one lead (Archive, Blue Lotus, Relay Seventeen).
objectives.player: Choose where to start digging.

objectives.text: Verify one historical identity with independent evidence (pulse: contact).
objectives.player: Prove one face from the past is who you think it is.

objectives.text: Get H03-H05 from their named sources (skipped packets reach Anansi).
objectives.player: Collect at least one packet from the street.

cast.note: Checkpoint officer: addresses a police chassis as a colleague. Social pressure, not a fight.
cast.name: BCPD Checkpoint Officer
cast.label: Compromised Protectorate Officer

cast.note: Tom Arlen can appear in person for Nia, or call through Serin's burner.
cast.label: Tom Arlen

cast.note: Mira Sol, if a PC contacts her for a temporary review.
cast.label: Mira Sol

missions.title: The Quiet Archive
missions.brief: A chapel of names on paper, kept by someone who refuses to wake the dead.
missions.gm: Main contact Father Ash. Optional personal contact: Tom for Nia, Deacon Marr for Edda, Iris Tan for Solenne or Sabine. Evidence E01, E03.

objectives.text: Receive H03, the Quiet Archive's paper record.
objectives.player: Get the Archive's paper record.

objectives.text: Agree the Archive's terms: read-only, no waking anyone who declined.
objectives.player: Agree to the Archive's terms.

objectives.text: Resolve a personal contact's scene (optional).
objectives.player: Speak to someone you used to know.

cast.note: Father Ash / Hyeon Park. Holds the sealed paper warrant (E01 fallback).
cast.label: Father Ash

cast.note: Deacon Marr, for Edda.
cast.label: Deacon Marr

cast.note: Iris Tan, for Solenne or Sabine.
cast.label: Iris Tan

cast.note: Tom Arlen, for Nia.
cast.label: Tom Arlen

missions.title: Blue Lotus, Black Water
missions.brief: Empty pools, chlorine and a ledger of deliveries nobody signed for.
missions.gm: Main contact Niko Saint; Hale Mercer for Cass or Anik. Ren Ko only if time and tension justify it; their objective is the physical ledger, not murder.

objectives.text: Receive H04, the Blue Lotus delivery ledger.
objectives.player: Get the delivery ledger.

objectives.text: Decide the ledger: copy it, buy it or take the original.
objectives.player: Decide what to do with the ledger.

objectives.text: Handle Ren Ko's competing offer (optional).
objectives.player: Deal with the other buyer.

cast.note: Niko Saint / Dax Marrow at his table on the drained pool floor.
cast.label: Niko Saint

cast.note: Ren Ko arrives to buy the same ledger; fights with the ADV02 profile if violence starts (G27).
cast.name: Ren Ko
cast.label: Palimpsest Retrieval Hitman

cast.note: Ren Ko's assistant.
cast.name: Ren Ko's Assistant
cast.label: Compromised Protectorate Officer

cast.note: Hale Mercer, especially for Cass or Anik.
cast.label: Hale Mercer

missions.title: Relay Seventeen
missions.brief: Warm air, humming cabinets and a log that should have been purged a century ago.
missions.gm: Main contact Lena Orr; optional Soren Gray. If skipped, her packet reaches Marlowe and she joins by audio.

objectives.text: Receive H05, the Relay Seventeen cold log.
objectives.player: Get the relay's cold log.

objectives.text: Choose read, mirror or purge at the console.
objectives.player: Decide what to do with the relay cache.

objectives.text: Secure Lena's maintenance token (E06 fallback).
objectives.player: Earn the engineer's maintenance token.

cast.note: Lena Orr / Keiko Marr at her open panel.
cast.label: Lena Orr

cast.note: Soren Gray, optional support.
cast.label: Soren Gray

missions.title: Anansi House
missions.brief: Rooms kept for you for a hundred and ten years, and a host who never forgot your orders.
missions.gm: Marlowe, Serin and one unresolved personal contact. First free anchor. Confront Serin with H06.

objectives.text: Establish Marlowe as an independent service AI.
objectives.player: Meet the house's host.

objectives.text: Confront Serin with H06 and confirm the reserves.
objectives.player: Make Serin explain herself.

objectives.text: Offer the first free anchor (Anansi).
objectives.player: Find something that still feels like yours.

objectives.text: All three street packets are in hand (H03-H05).
objectives.player: Gather every packet from the street.

objectives.text: Offer consent and read-only access alternatives (H15).
objectives.player: Agree how the archive may be read.

cast.note: Serin. If threatened she asks Iris to take custody of her statement.
cast.label: Dr Serin Kael

cast.note: The house AI speaks through the desk speaker; no token.
Unresolved personal contact: Tom has rebuilt a life.
cast.label: Tom Arlen

cast.note: Unresolved personal contact: Lena has abandoned a promise.
cast.label: Lena Orr

cast.note: Unresolved personal contact: Hale owes restitution.
cast.label: Hale Mercer

cast.note: Unresolved personal contact: Mira protects people from the charity Sabine funded.
cast.label: Mira Sol

cast.note: Unresolved personal contact: Deacon Marr can tell guilt from responsibility.
cast.label: Deacon Marr

missions.title: Palimpsest Virtuality
missions.brief: The case you died investigating, rebuilt from records — and records are not memories.
missions.gm: 35/45/55 minutes total for all nodes. Pulses 3 and 4 only. A Dipper only if the party opens the bidirectional channel.

objectives.text: Choose access: external replay, supervised dive or read-only.
objectives.player: Choose how to enter the archive.

objectives.text: Reconstruct the gate chronology (H07).
objectives.player: Rebuild the night of the raid.

objectives.text: Expose the forged consent (H08).
objectives.player: Find out what you supposedly agreed to.

objectives.text: Recover the audit credential (H09).
objectives.player: Recover the key you were carrying.

objectives.text: Every PC acts at least once inside.
objectives.player: Everyone has their moment inside.

cast.note: Recovery Dipper: only after the party knowingly opens the bidirectional diagnostic channel. One Data Engineering or Discipline D0 isolates it.
cast.name: Recovery Dipper
cast.label: Palimpsest Recovery Dipper

missions.title: The Court of Unreliable Witnesses
missions.brief: Eight chairs, eight outlines, and an accusation with an author.
missions.gm: The recorded interrogator's reflection shows Elias North over Lucan Vey. Pulse: Court node.

objectives.text: Find the second timestamp (H07).
objectives.player: Find the timestamp that does not match.

objectives.text: Run the Court memory pulse.
objectives.player: Sit in the witness chair.

objectives.text: Draft an audit petition or formal objection (optional).
objectives.player: Turn the contradiction into a legal tool.

cast.note: Recorded interrogator: Elias North's presentation layered over Lucan Vey's interface.
cast.label: Elias North

missions.title: The Operating Theatre
missions.brief: A clone breathing in an empty cradle, and two versions of one signature.
missions.gm: Spotlight Edda, Sabine and Anik. No automatic pulse. Serin's 2274 self knew the sheet overstated consent.

objectives.text: Compare the two consent documents (H08).
objectives.player: Compare the two consent forms.

objectives.text: Hear why the exception sheet was reworded.
objectives.player: Learn who changed the wording, and why.

cast.note: Memory of Dr Talia Venn (Serin, 2274) at the records desk.
cast.name: Dr Talia Venn (2274)
cast.label: Dr Serin Kael

missions.title: The Last Broadcast
missions.brief: Rain on the glass, four shares and a door marked for someone who was never meant to be there.
missions.gm: The recording ends as Asha's second team breaches. Elias North then messages through the audit channel. Pulse: Broadcast node.

objectives.text: Recover the audit route (H09).
objectives.player: Recover the audit route.

objectives.text: Run the Last Broadcast memory pulse.
objectives.player: Hear the last broadcast to its end.

objectives.text: Answer Elias North's invitation.
objectives.player: Answer the man who invited you back.

cast.note: Asha's second team in the 2274 recording: they breach as the record ends. Memory, not a live fight.
cast.name: Asha's Second Team (2274)
cast.label: Compromised Protectorate Officer

cast.note: Message through the audit channel; no token.

missions.title: Entering the Spire
missions.brief: The city's most public building, and the one door in it that is never open.
missions.gm: Turn relationships and evidence into access. Run only the chosen route: public audit, maintenance, witnessed custody or force. Renewal has not started.

objectives.text: Choose the entry: public audit, maintenance, witnessed custody or force.
objectives.player: Choose how you get in.

objectives.text: Reach the council.
objectives.player: Reach the people at the top.

cast.note: Captain Asha Rhyne meets a public-audit party in reception.
cast.label: Captain Asha Rhyne

cast.note: Elias North / Lucan Vey, if the route goes through him.
cast.label: Elias North

cast.note: Praetorian lead holds the access point and protects staff; withdraws to the council if untenable.
cast.name: Praetorian Lead
cast.label: Praetorian Black-Recovery Operative

cast.note: Spire guards. No automatic second wave.
cast.name: Spire Guard
cast.label: Compromised Protectorate Officer

cast.note: Lena Orr, for the maintenance route.
cast.label: Lena Orr

cast.note: Iris Tan, sponsoring a public audit.
cast.label: Iris Tan

missions.title: The Council Beneath the Skin
missions.brief: Three rulers at a table too small for a throne room, and the question nobody has been allowed to ask.
missions.gm: Establish independent Origin, Embodiment and Authority proofs. Sen volunteers her hand; Holt and Thale agree when all three are tested.

objectives.text: Origin: the root genesis register (H10).
objectives.player: Prove where they came from.

objectives.text: Embodiment: the organic attestation (H11).
objectives.player: Prove what they are wearing.

objectives.text: Authority: the civic dispatch (H12).
objectives.player: Prove what they control.

objectives.text: Run the three-voice continuity challenge (core pulse).
objectives.player: Hold on to who you are.

objectives.text: Offer the last grounding before the operation.
objectives.player: Take one breath before you act.

cast.note: Dr Adria Sen. Volunteers her hand, pulse and interface port.
cast.label: Dr Adria Sen

cast.note: Magistrate Severin Holt. Orders witnessed custody and records any attack.
cast.label: Magistrate Severin Holt

cast.note: Director Oren Thale. Keeps his credentials and an eye on the exit.
cast.label: Director Oren Thale

cast.note: Elias North at the clinical console; Lucan Vey's two-finger wrist tap.
cast.label: Elias North

missions.title: The Final Operation
missions.brief: Four rounds before the city signs itself over again.
missions.gm: Start Renewal 0/4 here. Each round every PC contributes once, then Renewal advances. Proof, Control and People each need two contributions; the chosen plan decides which matter.

objectives.text: Give H13: the three buses and the evidence port.
objectives.player: Understand the machine you are standing in.

objectives.text: Give H16: what can be chosen tonight.
objectives.player: Know what can be chosen tonight.

objectives.text: Start Renewal.
objectives.player: The clock starts.

objectives.text: Proof track 2/2.
objectives.player: Get the evidence out.

objectives.text: Control track 2/2.
objectives.player: Take the controls.

objectives.text: People track 2/2.
objectives.player: Keep the people safe.

objectives.text: Carry out the chosen operation.
objectives.player: Do what you came to do.

cast.note: Sen seeks cover and protects clinical residents.
cast.label: Dr Adria Sen

cast.note: Holt orders witnessed custody and records the attack.
cast.label: Magistrate Severin Holt

cast.note: Thale heads for the secure exit with his credentials; at Renewal 2 he offers a logistics bargain.
cast.label: Director Oren Thale

cast.note: Vey bargains for his usefulness.
cast.label: Elias North

cast.note: Asha: at Renewal 3 she separates armed participants from clinical staff; can be persuaded to witness.
cast.label: Captain Asha Rhyne

cast.note: Spire security; escorts from Renewal 3.
cast.name: Spire Security
cast.label: Compromised Protectorate Officer

missions.title: What Survives the Night
missions.brief: What the city keeps, what it forgets, and what stays yours.
missions.gm: Resolve evidence, authority and care separately. End on the last player's chosen detail.

objectives.text: Resolve evidence, authority and care separately.
objectives.player: See what the evidence did.

objectives.text: Name consequences for the witnesses, the reserves and civic staff.
objectives.player: See who carries the cost.

objectives.text: Ask every player what remains theirs.
objectives.player: Say what remains yours.

objectives.text: Record the chosen ending.
objectives.player: The night has an ending.

evidence.claim: The PCs were held under a 110-year evidence seal.
evidence.player: The withdrawal record: why you were held

evidence.claim: Retrieval orders demand intact stacks and private transfer.
The Foundation inherited Palimpsest's assets and liabilities.
evidence.player: The paper trail of an old project's money

evidence.claim: Serin arranged the awakening; two reserves are in protected storage.
evidence.player: Who woke you, and who is still asleep

evidence.claim: The final raid's chronology and purported group consent were altered.
evidence.player: The raid record does not match itself

evidence.claim: The 2274 archive includes a still-recognised audit credential.
evidence.player: An audit key that still works

evidence.claim: Three relevant minds began as AIs, not human DHFs.
Those same minds occupy the Benefactors' living organic clones.
Their identities issue binding civic-root instructions.
Administrative control can be removed without switching off basic services.

heat: Private search. Most city workers know nothing about the party.
Private search. Most city workers know nothing about the party.

Vey calls with a treatment-and-amnesty offer; known allies receive polite official pressure.
Asha prepares custody orders. One named contact must relocate or surrender a resource.
The Spire closes normal public admission. Maintenance entry or supervised custody still reaches the council.
heatPlayer: Nobody is looking for you yet.
Nobody is looking for you yet.
Your new faces are on checkpoint screens.

The people who know you are getting polite visits.
Custody orders are being drafted with your names on them.
